title: NEAT: Neighborhood-Guided, Efficient, Autoregressive Set Transformer for 3D Molecular Generation
abstract: arXiv:2512.05844v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformer-based autoregressive models offer an efficient alternative to diffusion- and flow-based approaches for generating 3D molecules. One challenge remains: standard transformer architectures require a sequential ordering of tokens, which is not inherently defined for the atoms in a molecule. Prior works have addressed this by using canonical atom orderings. However, these approaches are not permutation invariant w.r.t. atoms and bias next-token prediction towards ordering conventions. We overcome this limitation by introducing a novel neighborhood-guided training strategy. Our model, NEAT (Neighborhood-Guided, Efficient, Autoregressive Set Transformer) treats molecular graphs as sets of atoms and learns an order-agnostic distribution over admissible tokens at the graph boundary, thereby ensuring atom-level permutation invariance. NEAT achieves state-of-the-art generation quality on the QM9 and GEOM-Drugs datasets, enable

translated_title: NEAT：用于3D分子生成的邻域引导、高效、自回归集合Transformer
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的自回归模型为3D分子生成提供了一种区别于扩散模型和流模型的高效替代方案。然而仍存在一个挑战：标准Transformer架构需要token具有顺序排列，而对于分子中的原子来说，这种顺序并没有天然的定义。先前的工作通过使用规范原子排序来解决这一问题。然而，这些方法相对于原子不具备置换不变性，并且会使下一token的预测偏向于特定的排序惯例。我们通过引入一种新颖的邻域引导训练策略克服了这一限制。我们的模型NEAT（邻域引导、高效、自回归集合Transformer）将分子图视为原子的集合，并在图边界处学习一个与顺序无关的可容许token分布，从而确保了原子级别的置换不变性。NEAT在QM9和GEOM-Drugs数据集上实现了最先进的生成质量。
tldr: 提出NEAT模型，通过新颖的邻域引导训练策略将分子图视为原子集合并学习与顺序无关的token分布，实现原子级置换不变性，在QM9和GEOM-Drugs数据集上达到最先进的3D分子生成质量。
en_tdlr: NEAT introduces a novel neighborhood-guided training strategy that treats molecular graphs as sets of atoms and learns an order-agnostic token distribution, achieving atom-level permutation invariance and state-of-the-art 3D molecular generation quality on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs datasets.
